name: rad-coolify
description: An Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package for self-hosted Coolify v4 guidance and local checks. Optional live actions need client-specific MCP setup and cannot guarantee a successful deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Review and operate self-hosted Coolify v4 with care.
interface.longDescription: RAD Coolify is an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package with Codex compatibility metadata for self-hosted Coolify v4. Its skills cover deployment, databases, security, CI/CD, troubleshooting, monitoring, and infrastructure. Four local validators use heuristics. Live actions require a separate npm MCP package, Node.js, network access, Coolify credentials, and client support; those actions can change remote resources. The plugin cannot prove a deployment will work, and version-specific guidance can become stale.
defaultPrompt: Review this project for Coolify deployment risks.
Help me deploy this application to self-hosted Coolify.
